$comment: Board parity fixture (AP-IFW-010 / Track 9). Single plan with one task per v1 lifecycle column. Both v1 and v2 boards are driven against this fixture by test/parity/board/board-parity.spec.ts, which compiles `tasks[*].column` into the minimal event sequence (PlanApproved → TaskCreated → TaskApproved → AgentStarted with role-per-column) that lands each task in its target column. Adding or reordering columns here requires a matching update to the spec's role-by-column map.
